g.text: Squares: single runs; circles and ranges: 3 flow seeds sharing one representation.
Five new arms use strength 1.0 in a; baselines as fitted. V/T: validation/test; 0/1/2: seen class.
Direct coverage is sparse; the shuffle changes 30.65% of graph edges; assays are unpaired.
Controls are reused; GEARS uses extra GO. Post hoc internal comparison, not an official score.
